title: GROOT: Graph Edge Re-growth and Partitioning for the Verification of Large Designs in Logic Synthesis
problem: GNN-based verification for large circuits lacks joint framework considering chip domain knowledge, graph theory, and GPU optimization, leading to memory bottlenecks.
method: Algorithm-system co-design with polarized node feature extraction, graph partitioning algorithm with edge re-growth, and specialized GPU kernels (HD-kernel, LD-kernel) for high/low-degree node handling.
key_novelty: First algorithm-system co-design framework for GNN-based logic synthesis verification with domain-specific GPU optimization.
contributions: Polarized AIG node feature extraction for domain knowledge
Graph partitioning with edge re-growth for accuracy recovery
Dual GPU kernel design for heterogeneous node distributions
59.38% memory reduction with 99.96% accuracy on 1B-node circuits
primary_theme: GNN-based verification with GPU-optimized kernels for large circuits
